title: 132/33 kV Substation Tie-in for a Data Center Campus
scope: Two 90 MVA transformers, 132 kV gantries, control building and 33 kV cable route to the campus. Includes a planned utility outage window to tie in.
assume: Air-insulated 132 kV yard: 3 gantry bays, line bay with disconnectors, CTs, VTs and SF6 breakers per transformer.
Utility outage window shown as a status change on the incoming line (grey = de-energized).
